Done. All 1248 tests in the `gson` module pass (0 failures, 0 errors).

The fix is in gson/src/main/java/com/google/gson/JsonPrimitive.java:284 — when either integral primitive wraps a `BigInteger`, `equals` now compares the full values via `getAsBigInteger()` instead of truncating to `longValue()`, which previously dropped the high bits of BigIntegers exceeding `Long.MAX_VALUE`. Cross-type equality for small values (e.g. `Byte(10)` vs `BigInteger("10")`) and the long-based `hashCode` remain unchanged and consistent.
